title: The photograph of Buddy's band in Covington
summary: Allen asks about the Covington photograph; Zardis recalls a drinking day and a fellow taking the band's picture.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yes. You know that picture taken with you and Buddy Petit over there in Mandeville?
That's Covington we're taking at you.
That's Covington. Can you remember the circumstances under which that picture was taken or, you know, anything about it to enlarge upon that picture at all? I mean, to describe the circumstances?

Well, no, it was no more than one day. We was, we was out, we was drinking and I used to drink then. And we had some fellow want to take, take the band's picture. So, we all agreed to him to take the picture. And we went out and it's a big place, you know, in New York. That's taken in the yard by the fence. And he's taking that picture. Even the boy that sings, I didn't know his name, you see. Yeah, they never did get his name. No, they never did get his name. And much as we used to be together, but I...

You don't remember where that was exactly? I mean, that was in Covington? That was in Covington. Yeah, yeah, I know that. Well, now tell me about Buddy's playing, because you know he was never recorded or anything. I remember that.
